title: Q-ASHBY-waves: dispose of Ashby keyword Waves
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** ashbyarchive pass: Ashby's keyword "Waves" (18 references, pages 2, 38, 39, 59, 89, 101, 134, 140, 145, 152, 237, 249 ...) shares pages with the systems categories and has no disposition
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ashbyarchive --probe waves
**Prediction:** archive_triaged_share >= 1.0 within 720 h
**Out of scope:** copying the journal's wording into the repository; marking a keyword not-applicable without a reason a reader can check
**Status:** open

Read the cited pages (https://ashby.info/journal/index/index.html#waves; page images at https://ashby.info/journal/page/NNNN.html, transcribed summaries at https://ashby.info/journal/summaries) and dispose of the keyword in doctrine/ashby-archive.json: add it to a principle (our own statement, the pages, the code that carries it, a probe), or to `not_applicable` with the reason. A principle whose code does not exist yet is status item, with its own item.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ashbyarchive --probe waves`
